title: What It Actually Looks Like to Lead Your Younger Siblings Without Bossing Them
caption:
Oldest brother. You've been told you're supposed to set the example since you were nine.

Most of us turned that into being the loudest one in the house. That's not leadership. That's volume.

Go first into the hard stuff. Correct less and show up more. Let them see you fight your sin honestly. Serve the ones under you.

"Whoever would be great among you must be your servant." Mark 10:43

Send this to the oldest brother in your life.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #family #leadership
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
